仅将本次原文发送给本机 llama-server。译文仅你可见；复制后可自行粘贴: The original text is sent only to your local llama-server. The translation is visible only to you; copy and paste it to send it yourself.

等待本地模型响应，首次加载可能较慢。: Waiting for the local model. Initial loading may take a while.
connectionSuccess: Connected. Available models: {models}. Open the translator to test generation.
自动翻译已开启。返回聊天即可查看译文。: Automatic translation enabled. Return to the chat to see translations.
开关立即保存。使用已保存的模型与目标语言，逐条翻译视野内的文字消息；成功后只显示: This toggle saves immediately. Visible messages are translated one at a time using the saved model and target language. Only the translation is shown on success; right-click to view the original. Scrolling and new messages are handled automatically; turning it off restores originals. Channel names, thread titles, timestamps and nearby original messages provide context.
支持本机根地址、/v1 或完整 /v1/chat/completions 地址。: Supports a local server root URL, /v1 or the full /v1/chat/completions URL. Save settings to apply changes.
留空时从 /v1/models 自动选择第一个模型；多个模型时建议明确填写。: Leave empty to select the first model from /v1/models. Specify a name when using multiple models.
仅在服务器启用鉴权时填写；该值保存在 BetterDiscord 本地配置中，未: Only needed when server authentication is enabled. Stored unencrypted in BetterDiscord's local configuration.
默认简体中文；选择后点击保存设置，用于消息翻译与自动翻译。: Defaults to Simplified Chinese. Save your selection to apply it to message translation and automatic translation.
首次加载或 CPU 推理较慢时可增加，范围 5–600。: Increase this for initial loading or slower CPU inference. Range: 5–600.
译文过长时可增加，范围 128–8192。: Increase this for longer translations. Range: 128–8192.
按 llama-server 每个槽位的实际上下文容量填写。默认 8192；包含: Use llama-server's actual context capacity per slot. Default: 8192, including input and output. Space is reserved for maximum output. A conservative estimate reduces reference content first and never truncates the message.
默认英文，也可在聊天输入框右侧调整。与接收消息的默认目标语言独立；输入框旁开关立: Defaults to English and can also be changed beside the composer. Independent of the incoming target language. The composer toggle saves immediately and translates only when you send.
右键左侧频道、论坛或帖子，选择“打开自定义翻译”后在此配置。按固定版区 ID 保: Right-click a channel, forum or thread and enable custom translation, then configure it here. Bindings use channel IDs and survive renames. Threads use their own configuration or inherit the parent forum's. Glossaries add terminology to translation; automatic translation has its own toggle. Save settings after changes.
可指定任意本地 JSON 术语表。未指定路径时使用普通翻译；编辑文件后，新翻译会: Use any local JSON glossary. An empty path uses ordinary translation. File edits are read by subsequent translations. Removing a thread configuration restores inheritance from its parent forum.
插件未启用，仍可保存设置和测试连接；启用后可打开翻译器。: The plugin is disabled. You can still save settings and test the connection. Enable it to open the translator.
请求缓存最多 100 条、有效期 5 分钟；自动翻译按频道保留译文，返回频道时直: Requests are cached for 5 minutes, up to 100 entries. Automatic translations are retained by channel and restored on return. Up to 20 channels with 500 messages each are kept. Changing translation settings or disabling the plugin clears them.
pluginDescription: LLM-powered Discord translation with automatic, per-message, and pre-send translation.
settingsIntro: Supports automatic, per-message, and pre-send translation. Automatic translation shows only the translation; right-click to view the original. Click a language badge to change one message's target language, or use the circular arrows to change the default automatic target. The paper-plane toggle beside the composer controls pre-send translation. Translations can use channel topics, chat context, original replies, and custom glossaries.
defaultLanguageHelp: Selecting a language saves and applies it immediately, clears message overrides and refreshes translations. No bottom Save button is needed. Automatic translation keeps its on/off state; the outgoing language is independent.
applyDefaultLanguage: Apply default language and clear message overrides
includeOriginalHelp: Saved immediately. Send the original, a newline and the translation with an AI translation label in the target language. When off, send only the translation.
outgoingTooLong: The complete message exceeds the Discord limit. Shorten the original or turn off inclusion of the original.
unsupportedAiLabel: To include the original, select a supported outgoing language from the menu.
outgoingMarkdownBoundary: The original or translation contains unclosed code/spoiler markers or a quote spanning sections. Fix the formatting or turn off inclusion of the original. Your draft was kept.
serviceHelp: Local: root URL or /v1. Online: HTTPS API base URL or full /chat/completions URL. Save to apply.
modelHelp: Enter the provider model ID, or leave blank to list /models. Online connection tests send a short test message when a model is specified.
transmissionNotice: Original text and selected context are sent to the configured service. Online services may charge fees. Use the required API Key.
httpsRequired: Remote online API URLs must use HTTPS.
invalidResponse: Invalid JSON response. Check API URL and compatibility.
serverHint: Check service status, quota and API compatibility.
connectionFailed: Cannot connect to the model service. Check address, port and network.
onlineConnectionSuccess: Connected: {model}. The short test request completed.
onlineContextHelp: Use the model context capacity documented by the provider, including input and reserved output. Conservative estimates reduce references when needed without truncating the message.
settingsChangesHelp: Changes on this page apply only with Save and close. Cancel or closing the window discards them.
outgoingOriginalMode: Send original; click for translation only
outgoingTranslatedMode: Send translation only; click for original and translation
outgoingBilingualMode: Send original and translation; click for original only
outgoingSwitchBusy: Translating before sending; click to cancel and switch send mode
deepseekHelp: Thinking is off by default. When enabled, output tokens include reasoning and translation; reasoning is never displayed or sent. Connection tests use the current thinking settings, capped at 2048 generated tokens when thinking is on.
deepseekModelHelp: Enter a DeepSeek model ID, e.g. deepseek-flash or deepseek-v4-pro. A blank ID defaults to deepseek-flash.
deepseekEffortInvalid: DeepSeek thinking effort must be low, high or max.
